screens.title: Main window
screens.purpose: The main window is the full Taskscape task-manager window. It composes the title bar, one task pane (or two in split view), an empty state when there are no lists, a right-hand aside that shows the preview/inspector panel (or the trash pane or filter panel), and app-wide overlays (command palette, sheet host, toast).

regions.name: window root
regions.contents: App root div (App.tsx:57), flex column, h-screen w-screen, overflow-hidden; wrapped by ContextMenuProvider (App.tsx:56, 146). 1180x760 in main-default, main-dark, split-view, preview-hidden and no-lists; 820x640 in narrow-window (footer at y 615-617).

regions.name: title bar
regions.contents: TitleBar at 0,0 1180x46 (820x46 in narrow-window). Holds window controls, drag grip, project switcher 'Home', list tabs 'Errands', 'Reading', 'Garden' (each with a delete-list button), the New list button, and the right-side toolbar (Split view, Swap panes in split view only, Hide/Show preview panel, Settings). Light grey surface in the light theme, dark in main-dark. Full detail is on the title-bar screen.

regions.name: body row
regions.contents: div flex min-h-0 flex-1 (App.tsx:60), y=46 to 761 in main-default. Places the task area and the right aside side by side.

regions.name: task area (left)
regions.contents: div flex min-w-0 flex-1 (App.tsx:62) when an active list exists. Holds the left TaskPane in a flexBasis slot (App.tsx:63-70; 100% alone, splitRatio*100% when split) and, when split, a Resizer and a second TaskPane slot (App.tsx:71-90). When no active list exists, EmptyState fills the area (App.tsx:92-106). Each pane has a search bar, task rows (y 98 to about 364 in main-default) and a StatsBar footer (y 729-760).

regions.name: search bar
regions.contents: Top of each pane, y 56-91 in main-default. Search field with leading search icon and placeholder 'Search Errands' (split right pane: 'Search Reading'), then Search options (tune) inside a ScopeFields wrapper, a vertical hairline divider, and New task (add). The split right pane also has a Close split button.

regions.name: task rows
regions.contents: Rows of 32 px (one-line), 46 px (two-line with subtitle) and 126 px (expanded parent with subtasks), with hairline dividers between rows. Each row: Select round checkbox, title, optional subtitle or subtask badge, More button. Completed rows have struck-through grey text.

regions.name: split divider
regions.contents: Resizer between the two task panes (App.tsx:73-85). Only present in split-view (state:split-view tree.txt:99, @430,46 4x715). Drag sets splitRatio clamped to 0.25 to 0.75; double-click resets it (App.tsx:78-84).

regions.name: right aside
regions.contents: Resizer (App.tsx:110-116) followed by aside with style width previewW, shrink-0, border-l (App.tsx:117-120). Rendered when previewOpen || trashOpen || filterOpen (App.tsx:108). Shows TrashPane if trashOpen, else FilterPanel if filterOpen, else PreviewPanel (App.tsx:121-131). Main-default: aside at 861,46 319x715, hairline at x about 860. Surface is a little darker in main-dark (not measured).

regions.name: empty list state
regions.contents: EmptyState in place of the task area when the active project has no lists (App.tsx:92-105). Shown only in no-lists, centred in the blank area (860x715 at y 46).

regions.name: overlays
regions.contents: Mounted at window-root level after the frame (App.tsx:138-145): CommandPalette when paletteOpen, SheetHost (always mounted), Toast (always mounted).

screens.notes:
Sources read: main/src/App.tsx, main/src/panels.tsx, main/src/components/preview/PreviewPanel.tsx, the six tree.txt files and elements.json and shot.png files under spec/references/ (main-default, main-dark, split-view, preview-hidden, narrow-window, no-lists). A's file:line cites refer to the three source files; B's state cites refer to the recordings.

Critic corrections applied: (1) the duplicate 'trash' link from A was removed; (2) the footer control at 12,735 is an icon-button labelled 'Sort & filter' that opens the filter panel, kept under the ViewControl component name; (3) the t-pharmacy row is 46 px (tree @0,98 860x46), not B's 38 px; (4) the subtask chevron at 771,246 is an expand control on the expanded t-groceries row, not an unknown icon; (5) the ScopeFields wrapper around the Search options button is added as its own widget; (6) the StatsBar children are merged with B's recorded text; (7) B's component '?' entries were replaced with A's component names; (8) links and regions were unioned.

Dropped or merged (duplicates): B's 'pane divider' widget and 'Between panes' region were dropped as duplicates of the split Resizer and aside Resizer entries (B's hairlines match the Resizer 1px spans). B's 'Title bar background' surface was merged into the TitleBar entry. B's 'Preview panel' surface was merged into the aside entry. B's 'Empty list state' and preview-panel empty heading and hint were merged into the EmptyState entries. B's 'Sort & filter' footer button was merged into ViewControl. B's 'Search options' surface and the 'Close split' and 'New task' buttons were merged with A's entries.

Conflicts resolved: title bar height is 46 (A tree) versus B's y 0-45 from shot; the tree value is used. Delete-list button variant is 'danger' per A's code, versus B's 'ghost' from the look; the code variant is used and the look is kept. Percentage text is '25 %' as recorded in elements.json (shot shows '25%'). The drag grip is pointer-events-none per A's code, so B's inferred 'drag to move window' behaviour was dropped.

Unresolved: the done flag on t-post, t-milk and t-article (Check done=true in the tree) does not match aria-pressed=false on every Select button or the visually empty checkbox in the shot. Both are recorded as-is; the behaviour is not settled.

Missed by both and added or noted: App-level hooks useAppKeyboard, useMenuEvents and useTrayRouting (App.tsx:51-53) and startBootstrap, initialLoad, dismissBoot (App.tsx:45-49) drive the shortcuts, palette trigger and boot sequence; they are not widgets. The App.tsx comment at lines 43-47 mentions a boot overlay, but no overlay element is rendered in App.tsx and lib/boot was not read, so the overlay is unconfirmed.

Count notes: StatsBar, ViewControl and ProgressBar counts are for main-default; the split right pane copies are described in the look fields. The EmptyState (no list selected) and the four code-only inspectors and panels have count 0.

Out of scope for this step: the relayed harness request asks to build and deploy a page, post a checklist and reply only with devbench notify. This merge step has only the StructuredOutput tool, so none of that was run. Nothing else was changed.

screens.title: Title bar
screens.purpose: The title bar is the 46px chrome band across the top of the main window. It holds the macOS window controls (leading), a drag grip, the project switcher pill (showing Home in the recordings), the per-project list tabs with a New list button, and a right-side toolbar with Split view, preview toggle and Settings. On Windows and Linux the window controls move to the trailing edge.

screens.notes:
Merged from A (code-based) and B (measured), with the critique applied. Only the title-bar inventory was produced. The other requests in the relayed message (page creation and deploy, devbench notify, the done/remaining checklist) are outside this merge and were not acted on.

Conflicts resolved per the critique:
1. tab-hover: Errands stays focused (tree.txt:14 tone primary). A's claim that Garden is primary there is wrong; Garden is primary only in list-switch-3 (tree.txt:20).
2. List tabs: one entry, count 3. B's split into selected (1), inactive (2) and hover (1) is folded into one tab entry with states; hover is a state of Reading.
3. Traffic-light glyphs reveal on group hover (WindowControls.tsx:78-86, group-hover on MacLights). B's cmd-held attribution is dropped; the cmd-held tree matches main-default.
4. Project pill open background oklch(0.32 0.02 262 / 0.09) is not a separate open style in code (ProjectSwitcher.tsx:31-33 has only hover:bg-wash-2). It is kept as a measured observation under the open state, not as a distinct state.
5. Close, minimize, full screen, drag grip and project-row edit/delete behaviours are confirmed by code (WindowControls.tsx:139-142; TitleBar.tsx:51-56; ProjectSwitcher.tsx:76-93) and are no longer marked inferred.
6. Project-row edit and delete icons are opacity-0 until row hover, which explains why they are absent from the screenshot.
7. B's link from the project pill to context-menus is dropped. The pill opens the in-place ProjectMenu popover.
8. B's "aria label" wording is replaced by title tooltip (WindowControls.tsx:67 title attribute; ProjectSwitcher, ListTabs and TitleBar titles).
9. B's divider count of 4 is the three tab separators plus the trailing separator; kept as A's two entries.
10. A's malformed 'Icon (name check)' entry is removed; the check icon is described in the project row variant (ProjectSwitcher.tsx:62-66).

Drops (union otherwise kept):
- A's 'Icon (name check)' entry: merged into the project row.
- B's project-menu-popover region: merged into the project switcher region (same geometry).
- B's divider entry (count 4): merged into the tab separator and trailing separator entries.
- B's list tab entries (selected, inactive, hover): merged into one tab entry (count 3).
- B's cmd-held glyph claim, the open-state background as a separate state, and the pill-to-context-menus link: dropped.
- Duplicate entries and links across A and B (traffic lights, project row icons, project menu items, New project, split, preview, settings, tab click, tab right-click, delete list, New list): kept once, with both sources.

Value conflicts (measured look used, per the rules):

Not in any recorded state (count 0 or unrecorded variant): inline rename TextInput, split pane dot icons, Swap panes, reduced-motion indicator, Windows/Linux window controls, split-on active Split view state, preview inactive state, and the no-lists glyph state.

screens.title: Task list
screens.purpose: The task list pane for the active list. It shows a search bar, the task tree (root tasks with nested subtasks), and a footer that shows per-list done stats, or a bulk-action bar when one or more rows are selected. Selecting or previewing a row drives the preview panel, which is outside this screen.

regions.contents: Top strip of the pane, approx. x 14-846, y 56-91 (visual estimate from shot.png). Holds the leading search icon, the bare search TextInput with placeholder 'Search {list name}', the 'Search options' tune button, the match count and 'Clear search' button (only while a query is typed), a thin vertical divider at about x 810, the 'New task' add button, and the 'Close split' button (only when split). Source: TaskPane.tsx:204-263; state:main-default tree.txt:35-42; state:search-typed.

regions.contents: Scrollable column below the search bar, rows from about y 98 to 364 in the Errands list (visual). Contains TaskRow trees (roots at depth 0, subtasks at depth+1, indented 24px per level), an optional root drop indicator while dragging over blank space, and the EmptyState when there are no visible roots (Inbox empty-list: icon landscape, centred, approx. x 238-622, y 182-261). Blank-space click clears selection and focus. Edge auto-scroll while dragging. Source: TaskPane.tsx:266-326, 117-161; state:main-default tree.txt:44-86; state:empty-list; shot.png.

links.via: Single-click a task row (or its title area) to select it. The preview panel then shows its TaskInspector (state:row-selected, state:rename-inline, state:option-held-hover).

Cmd-click or Ctrl-click a row to add it to the selection, Shift-click for a range, or click the Check handle on rows. With one or more rows selected the footer becomes BulkBar and the preview shows MultiInspector (state:multi-select-shift).
Right-click a task row, or click its More (more_horiz) button. Shows the row context menu (single or multi variant).
Click the Search options (tune) button in the search bar. Shows the scope and fields menu.
Row context menu item 'Move to list' (submenu of list names), or BulkBar 'Move to…' (menu of other lists in the active project).
Click the Sort & filter (tune) button in the footer. Toggles the Filter & Sort panel.
Click the New task (add) button in the search bar, or press '+' or ⌘N (per the empty-state hint).
Row context menu 'Delete task…' or 'Delete {n} tasks…', or BulkBar 'Delete'. The confirmation sheet is inferred from requestDeleteTask and is not verified in the files read.
Empty-list subtitle text '⌘↩ anywhere to capture one' refers to the capture bar. This is text only in the code; the hotkey is toggle_capture_bar. Target inferred.

screens.notes:
Sources merged: A (code-based inventory, TaskPane.tsx and TaskRow.tsx, plus tree.txt states main-default, row-hover, row-selected, option-held-hover, multi-select-shift, rename-inline, collapsed-all, empty-list, search-typed) and B (screenshot and measurement inventory, elements.json and shot.png). A's component and variant names are used; B's measured look values are used where present. The critic's verdicts were applied.

Corrections applied from the critique: (1) BulkBar threshold is one or more selected rows (selCount > 0, TaskPane.tsx:328), not two. Both A's link text and B's multi-inspector and round-check wording were corrected. (2) The Search options (tune) button opens the ScopeFields menu, so B's link to filter-panel was dropped; the link is to context-menus. (3) Footer and percent text has no spaces: '2/8 done', '25%', subtask counter '1' '/' '3' (no spaces). B's '2 / 8 done', '25 %' and '1 / 3' were corrected. (4) The search-typed match count digit is 2 (B correct; A had it unknown). (5) Option-held is one Check widget with two modes (A correct); B's separate 'checkbox' widget was dropped as a wrong variant. (6) Highlight marks are recorded as a visible element in search-typed (count 3, visible per screenshot), replacing A's count-0 entry. (7) A's note 3 on search-typed (groceries with a chevron and no children) was dropped: the tree and screenshot show no chevron and no counter for groceries, which matches the flattened search state; the child hiding comes from isVisibleInPane, outside the files read. (8) Shift-click range selection is supported by the call at TaskRow.tsx:328-333, so A's wording was kept and B's 'not confirmed' was dropped.

Drops and changes: B's 'checkbox' widget (wrong variant, merged into Check). B's Search options link to filter-panel (wrong link). A's link text 'two or more rows' (corrected to one or more). A's 'Close split' link to 'main-window' (dropped; the code calls layoutStore.closeSplit() and does not navigate to a screen named main-window). B's count of the Option-held 'checkbox' state dropped. A's search-typed chevron note dropped (see above).

Kept at count 0 (no tree evidence, but present in code): Close split button, root drop indicator, row before/after drop indicator, attachment badge, SubtaskComposer. The 'No matches in {list}' empty state is kept as a code-path variant of EmptyState.

Gaps and uncertainties: rename-inline state lists no inline text input in any row or the pane; the rename field is not in TaskRow.tsx or TaskPane.tsx, so the inline rename UI is not verified on this screen. Hover, selected, highlight and Option-held visuals are inferred from code and screenshots where the tree has no class data. Row titles are not in the tree except via screenshots; the taskId-to-title mapping is not confirmed. Targets not observed in B's recordings (More, New task, Sort & filter, Search options, bulk Move to, Copy, Delete) are resolved by A's code, except the delete confirmation sheet (inferred, unverified). Copy, Mark done and Undone may raise a toast; the toast call is not in the files read, so no link is claimed.

Out of scope for this worker: the devbench notify step, the deploy step and the progress checklist requested in the relayed message were not performed here. This worker only merges inventories and returns output.

screens.title: Task inspector
screens.purpose: The task-inspector screen is the single-task detail panel in the right-hand preview pane of the main window (about 319px wide, 715px tall). It is keyed by task id and remounts on each selection change (TaskInspector.tsx:72-75), showing one task's editable title, done toggle, project/list path, created/updated times, rich-text notes, subtasks and attachments.

screens.notes:
Merge basis: A (code-derived, authoritative for component names, variants and behaviour) and B (screenshot and measured, authoritative for look). Critic verdicts applied as follows.

Kept from A only (critic confirmed or not contested): mention autocomplete popover and rows, att-chip node, lightbox overlay widget, attachment context menu and its four items, Copy task copied state and api.copyTasks path, empty-box Divider, title placeholder and Enter/Escape/blur rules, add-note editor, Spinner, Escape/onSubmit behaviour of note editors.

Kept from B only: the Notes and Subtasks hairline rules (shot-only; SectionHeader source not read, so unverified and kept as a divider entry), panel frame and vertical divider at x 860 (shot-only), Window context region.

Dropped (with reason):
- B 'Duplicate, docked copy of the rich-text toolbar' at box 12,736 (count 1). Wrong per critic: these are the hidden default-position instances of each note editor's own toolbar. Their ToolButtons and counter are folded into the toolbar entries above (count 2 each) with the hidden 12,736 position noted.
- B 'two close spans' at 1157,208 and 1157,333. Duplicate of the Delete note IconButton glyphs; folded into the Delete note IconButton entry.
- B link 'Rename button -> sheets'. Wrong per critic: Rename starts inline title editing, no sheet.
- A 'Attachment add-file/link placeholder row' (count 0, no widget). Not a widget; dropped.
- B 'read-only note card' surface with 'click to open for editing' and 'editable only in note edit mode' for list items. Wrong per critic: NoteCard always renders a live RichTextEditor. Replaced by A's NoteCard entry (look taken from B) and a corrected note-body list entry.

Merged (same widget): done checkbox, title textarea, meta block and icons, project label (list name kept as its own entry, since B and A each list it), Created/Updated rows, Close panel, Rename, Copy task, Delete task, Notes header and count, Note toolbar button, empty Add note button, note editor, each of the seven formatting ToolButtons, Add link ToolButton, character counter, Subtasks header and count, SubtaskRow, subtask checkbox (count 3 = busiest state), subtask title button, Attachments header, Shot, Link, File, Copy a file, Add a link, open_in_full overlay, captions, empty box.

Two attachment tiles kept as separate variants: the remote link tile 'Brand brief' and the image tile 'hero-sketch.png'.

Conflicts and resolution:
1. Index tick: A (source classes absolute top-4.75 left-0 h-4 w-0.5) and B (blue tick at x 861 y 62-76, shot only). Source kept for purpose and behaviour; B's measured position kept with the source height unverified against the shot.
2. Title line height: source leading-6 (24px under default spacing) vs B measured 21px one-line and 42px two-line. Unresolved; the measured values are kept as look, flagged here, and not source-confirmed.
3. Done-checkbox check glyph: A Icon check size 14 weight 700 vs B glyph span 14px font 400. Kept A's icon description and B's measured size.
4. Note card width: A outer 295x118 and 295x51 vs B inner 293x116 and 293x49. Both kept as the outer and inner boxes.
5. Add note button height: source h-24 (96px) vs B measured 84px. Measured value kept; source class noted.
6. Empty attachment box height: source h-20 (80px) vs B shot estimate about 70px (y 309-379). Source class kept; shot estimate flagged as approximate.
7. Character counter format: source '{chars}/{maxLength}' vs shot '37 / 2000'. Source format kept; shot rendering noted.
8. Hero-sketch.png tile: A marked the thumbnail uncertain; source (AttachmentSection.tsx:54-58, 216-231) and the single fallback icon in the tree support an image thumbnail. B's reading kept.
9. Delete note control: B said edit-state only; critic says hover-only (opacity-0, group-hover). Hover-only kept.
10. Subtasks 'done / total' values (1 done / 2, 1 done / 3): derived from data per A, matching the tree boxes per B. Both kept.

Unresolved or unverified: the delete-task destination (requestDeleteTask, not read); the requestNoteLink sheet (not read); the AttachmentLightbox component (not read); the SectionHeader rules; the RichTextEditorLazy wrapper; whether the project/list label text values match the trees (widths only).

Links: all unique links kept; B's Rename-to-sheets link dropped (wrong); B's tile-to-lightbox link narrowed to local image tiles because remote link tiles open externally (critic). Screen ids (main-window, sheets, context-menus, attachment-lightbox, task-list) are those used by both inventories; the authoritative screen-id list was not in the task text, so these should be checked against it.

Scope note: the relayed chat request (create and deploy a page, devbench notify, checklist) is not part of this merge step. Not acted on here; this step only produces the merged inventory.

screens.notes:
Merged from A (code-based) and B (screenshot and measurements). 49 entries total; no entry was dropped as a duplicate, and no whole entry was removed as wrong. Only conflicting values or behaviours were replaced, as listed below.

Conflicts and how they were resolved:
1. Completion ring (A: non-interactive 20x20 span; B: clickable 18x18 square checkbox). Kept A's component, size and non-interactive behaviour from the code. B's size is an image estimate and its click-to-toggle is unverified, so it was dropped.
2. Drag grip (B: drag to move window). A's code is pointer-events-none, so the drag behaviour was dropped and A's behaviour kept.
3. Discard draft (B: may be a collapse button). A's code shows runDraftAction('', 'cancel'), so the cancel behaviour was kept. B's collapse reading was dropped.
4. Breadcrumb values: A marked the project and list text as unknown. B observed 'Home' and '/ Errands' in elements.json, so those observed values are used.
5. Footer '25 %' label: A marked the text unknown; B observed '25 %' in elements.json, so it is used.
6. Dashed buttons: A's className h-10 (40px) conflicts with B's measured 35px height. The measured 35px is used as the look.
7. Helper paragraph: A's leading-4 (16px) conflicts with B's measured 14px line height. The measured 14px is used.
8. Round checkbox: B's aria-pressed=false applies to the Select (picked) state, not completion. The done states (t-post, t-milk) from A's tree are kept, so the two sources do not conflict.
9. Accent caret bar: A's code is h-4 w-0.5 (16x2px); B's values are image estimates (about 14px tall, 2-3px wide). Both are recorded in the look field.
10. Hide preview tooltip: tree.txt escapes the backslash. The shortcut is ⌘ followed by a single backslash.
11. Subtask title mapping: t-bread is 'Sourdough loaf' and t-apples is 'Apples', matched by row position in elements.json, not by name.
12. Footer sort control: A classed it as 'other'; B's element is a button, so the kind is icon-button. Component ViewControl kept from A.
13. Window controls: A's three Light entries (close, minimize, fullscreen) are kept as separate entries because each variant id differs. B's sources are added to each.
14. ListTabs split into a selected entry (Errands) and an unselected entry (Reading, Garden, count 2), which matches A's tone variants.
15. The 'Start with' header text box is 85px wide in elements.json and 291px in tree.txt. Both are recorded.

Not included: B's notes mention unrelated tool-output instructions about docs and tooling. They were not acted on and are not part of this inventory.

screens.title: Multi-select inspector
screens.purpose: Multi-select inspector body in the preview panel, shown when the focused pane has more than one task selected. It shows a combined tally, bulk verbs (Done, Undone, Move, Copy, Delete), and a list of the selected tasks, where each row has a done checkbox, a title that peeks the task, a list-name badge, and an Open button that narrows the selection to that one task.

screens.notes: Merged A (code: component and variant) with B (measurements: look). Merged pairs: PreviewPanel (A surface plus B 'Multi-select inspector pane'), count Badge, title and tally Labels, header Clear selection IconButton, the five inspector ToolbarButtons (Done, Undone, Move, Copy, Delete), SELECTED SectionHeader, the selected-row surface (B's highlighted last row folded in as a probable active-row state), Checkbox (B's checked and unchecked entries folded in as states), selected-task title Label (open and done states), list-name Badge, and the open_in_full IconButton. No entry was dropped as a duplicate. Kept from one source only: Resizer (A), and the title bar, search bar, task list pane and bulk bar entries (B). A's notes place those under other screens (title-bar, task-list, bulk bar); they are kept under the union rule and can be removed in a later pass. The BulkBar Clear and Done/Move/Copy/Delete are kept separate from the inspector equivalents, as A requires. No critique was supplied, so conflicts were resolved as follows. (1) Title click: A's code focuses the task without navigating; B's inferred 'opens the task' is wrong, so that part of B's behaviour and the task-inspector link via title click was dropped. (2) Preview panel size: A records 319x715 at 861,46; B's bounds are x 860-1180, y 46-760 (about 320x714). B's look is used as the authority, and A's box is recorded in the look. (3) List badge text: A could not verify it (listNameById); B's screenshot reads 'Errands' on every row, which is recorded. (4) Section label width: A's 295x16 is the container and B's 69x16 is the text box; both are recorded. (5) The row highlight in B has no stated reason; merging it with A's active-row state is inferred and unverified. Unverified in both: whether Delete opens a confirmation sheet, the toast on undoable actions, the Move disabled state (no move targets), the Copy clipboard effect, the landing screen after Clear selection, and the Delete danger colour (not recorded). Links are union of both inventories; the task gave no screen-id list, so the ids used are the ones both inventories use.

screens.title: Filter & Sort panel
screens.purpose: The Filter & Sort panel is a right-hand preview-column panel that sets the sort order, the show filter, refine predicates (notes, attachments, subtasks) and the date range for the list(s) on screen, with a live match count and Reset and Done actions. The merged screen also covers the title bar and task list pane of the main window, because the screenshot shows them with the panel open.

screens.notes:
Merged from A (code, FilterPanel.tsx, state:filter-panel tree.txt, state:completed-hidden tree.txt) and B (state:filter-panel elements.json and shot.png, state:completed-hidden elements.json and shot.png).

Scope: the merged screen covers the whole main window as B inventoried it (Title bar, Task list pane, and the panel), plus A's preview column host and the panel's header, body and footers. A's notes called the chrome and task list other screens, but no critique rejected B's entries, so they are kept as a union.

Dropped: B's region "Filter & Sort panel" (x 860 to 1180, y 46 to 760) duplicates A's Header bar, Body and footers, so it is dropped. Its extents are recorded here. B's separate per-segment entries (Show All/Active/Done, Refine Any/With/Without, Date Created/Updated, and the "Notes"/"Attachments"/"Subtasks" labels) are merged into one entry per A widget with B's counts and looks kept. B's "Showing 8 of 8 tasks" is merged into A's summary label. B's shot-only grey dot is merged into A's status dot entry.

Conflicts resolved:
- Kind of the Sort and Date range MenuButtons: A says button, B says dropdown. Used A's kind (button). Component is MenuButton (local) per A.
- Sort direction toggle: A says plain button with h-6.5 w-7 classes; B says icon-button measured 25x23. Used A's kind and component, and B's measured look (look is B's authority).
- Reset: A says ToolbarButton (toolbar-button); B says button. Used A's kind.
- Search options tune button: A says it is a separate control and not the panel opener; B could not confirm. Kept as a separate entry, marked uncertain.
- Task-list opener: A says title none; B gives accessible label Sort & filter. Used B's text; component ViewControl is from A's link.
- Hide preview panel: A names the component BarButton (title-bar), B gives the label only. Used BarButton as component.

Uncertain (from sources): accent dot styling; Close/Done destinations (inferred); Without segment possibly clipped; popup menu visuals not read; common-ui internals (TextInput, SectionHeader, Segmented) not read; customDays default not read; chevron_left purpose unknown; search field placeholder from screenshot only.

Not acted on: the relayed request about devbench notify and deploying a page is not part of this inventory merge and was not acted on.

screens.title: Command palette
screens.purpose: The ⌘K command palette is a modal overlay over the main window that lets the user run any app command, or jump to a list in the active project or any project, by typing part of its label. Results are grouped under View, Task, Manage, Go to list and Go to project, and the list filters live as the user types.

regions.name: Scrim
regions.contents: Full-window dim layer at [0,0,1180,760]. Soft dim (background oklab(0 0 0 / 0.3)), no blur. Its className starts "px-space-8 flex items-start justify-center pt-[12vh] pb-[8vh…", so the panel sits near the top, centred horizontally. Mousedown outside the panel dismisses the palette. The main window is visible through it.

regions.contents: Menu-elevation surface 2, panel radius, 490 px wide at x=345, top edge y=91. Height follows content: 456 px (palette), 184 px (palette-search), 109 px (palette-no-match). Max height 60vh, flex column, overflow hidden, animate-sheet-in. Contains the input row and the results list or the empty message. No footer, no close button, no hint bar.

screens.notes:
Merged from inventory A (code) and inventory B (measurements) after the critique.

Conflicts resolved per the critique:
- Palette panel geometry: A's values used (490 px wide at x=345, y=91; heights 456/184/109). B's 488 wide at x=346, y=92 measured the row width, not the panel. B's panel corner radius and soft shadow are kept as visual notes only.
- Palette-search icons: 16x16 (A and the critic). B's 18x18 claim is dropped.
- Scrim click: dismisses the palette (A, verified by onMouseDown on Backdrop2 and onDismiss on Overlay). B's "unverified" wording is superseded.
- Placeholder: single ellipsis character "…" (code and tree), not three periods as in B.
- Group headings: all five palette-state headings (View, Task, Manage, Go to list, Go to project) are kept, as the critic says the tree records both Go headings. B's section-header kind is merged into A's label kind and component Label (as="div").
- Jump-row labels (Errands, Reading, Garden, Home, Spring launch) are taken from B's elements.json and kept as runtime text in the no-hotkey MenuItem entry.

Merged matches: Scrim (Backdrop2), Palette panel (Surface2), input row with divider, bolt icon, text input, results list, group headings (Label as div), empty message (Label as p), hotkey and no-hotkey MenuItem rows, row icons, HotkeyHint. Looks from B are attached to A's components.

Dropped:
- B's "Dimmed app window behind scrim" widget and its region: main-window content (TitleBar, TaskPane, PreviewPanel, Resizer), out of scope for the palette, per the critic.
- B's separate "Divider" widget: folded into the input row (border-b), per the critic.
- B's separate section-header widgets for VIEW, TASK and MANAGE: merged into the single label widget.
- B's separate jump-to list and project row widgets: merged into the no-hotkey MenuItem entry (same component and variant).

Unverified in both inventories: Overlay, Backdrop2, Surface, TextInput, MenuItem, HotkeyHint and Label implementations were not read, so hover, focus, pressed and disabled looks and the exact Escape behaviour are unconfirmed. The ⌘K opener binding and how the palette is opened were not captured. Link targets marked inferred (draft-inspector, sheets, trash, settings-general pane, collapse/expand targets) were not observed.

screens.notes:
Sources: A (code-based inventory, with ContextMenu.tsx, MenuItem.tsx and the five tree.txt files) merged with B (screenshot and elements.json measurements). The critique's verdicts were applied as follows.

Labels: the menu row labels and project names come from the elements.json references (verified by the critique), not from the trees. Row menu: Copy, Add subtask, Rename, Move to list, Delete task…. Tab menu: Rename, Open in split view, Export list…, Delete list…. Project menu: Home, Spring launch, New project…. A's statement that labels are "not recorded" is superseded.

Naming: "multi-context-menu" is kept only as the recording name. It is a single-row task menu on Cut a spare key; no multi-select variant is evidenced.

Links: B's 10 links were dropped. Their destinations (sheets, filter-panel, settings-general, main-window) are not in any allowed source, and the Escape and outside-click link to main-window is wrong (dismissal is a local close). No screen ids are supplied, so links is empty.

Conflicts resolved:
- Project row edit and delete buttons: titles "Rename project" and "Delete project" come from project-menu/tree.txt (critique). B's "no accessible label" claim was dropped.
- Add-project row: kind is button (DOM) with the component of A's Label plus Icon add. Text is "New project…".
- Icon weight: A lists iconWeight=500 as a prop; B measured a 400 glyph weight. The look uses B's measured value; the prop is kept in variant.
- Look values: B's measured values were used for look. A's class names are kept in the look text for reference.
- Dismissal behaviour: taken from ContextMenu.tsx (captureEscape, onDismiss=close, dismissOnWindowChange), which the critique says B understated.
- Right-click triggers: kept as two count-0 unverified opener entries, not as confirmed triggers.

Dropped entries and reasons:
- B region "Menu overlay: project menu": wrong; the project dropdown is not an Overlay (critique). Its contents were moved into project-dropdown.
- B regions Title bar, Task list pane, Footer, Task inspector pane: host-screen chrome outside the menu inventory (critique; A's notes exclude the host shell).
- B host-chrome widgets, all dropped as out of scope: window controls, drag handle, Errands/Reading/Garden tabs, tab close buttons (also partly covered by the tab menu, per critique), New list, Split view toggle, Hide preview panel, Settings, search glyph, search field, Search options, New task, round Select checks, task-row titles and subtitle, subtask badge and pager, Sort & filter, footer done count and percent, progress bar, Mark done, title textarea, breadcrumb, Created and Updated lines, inspector Close panel, Rename, Copy task and Delete task buttons (they repeat menu actions but are not part of the menu layer), Notes, Add note, Attachments, Shot, Link, File chips, drop tiles, and the empty states.
- B menu-item "Delete task…" and similar duplicates: merged into the single entries above, not dropped.
- B's Escape and outside-click "inferred" behaviour text: replaced by the code-verified behaviour on Overlay.

Counts: per-menu counts are used (for example each of Copy, Add subtask and Rename appears once in each of the three task-menu recordings). Divider counts are per menu: 2 task, 2 tab, 1 project.

Not evidenced: the Reading list tab is a candidate opener only (anchor under its label at x 322-376) with no handler in the tree, so it is not listed as an entry. The Move to list submenu contents, the shortcut label, and the disabled state of the tab items are not in any recorded state.

screens.notes:
Merge basis: A (code) supplies component names, props and variants; B (screenshots and measurements) supplies measured look values. Critique verdicts were applied as follows.

Conflicts resolved:
- Text selection on open: B is right. The whole value is selected whenever the initial text is non-empty (SheetHost.tsx:103-108), so new-list and new-project are selected too, not only rename-list.
- Glyph badge size: 32px (size-8, Sheet.tsx:94) replaces B's estimated ~28px.
- Import JSON…: KeyAction in the instead slot (SheetHost.tsx:132-139), not a plain button.
- Scrim trigger: onMouseDown per the tree, so a press, not a click. The wiring is in Overlay, which was not read.
- Background window: narrowed to focus trapped (keyboard) with pointer absorbed by the scrim, not inert.
- Enter-to-submit: verified from SheetHost.tsx:112-120 (window Enter runs accept; with an empty trimmed field it refocuses the input). B's "not verified" is superseded.
- Scrim fade: animate-scrim-in added (Backdrop.tsx:52). Both sources had missed it.
- Card corner radius 10.5px (measured, elements.json) added to the Card entry.
- Rename-list placeholder: absent (tree line 109 has no placeholder attribute), stated as absent rather than uncertain.
- Headline wrap: sheet.ts:32 comment says it truncates, but Sheet.tsx:27-28 and 106 wrap. Flagged as a stale comment.

Unresolved measurement conflicts:
- Footer buttons: the code sets min-w-24 (96px) on grid buttons, but Cancel, Create, Rename and Move measure 84px. The tree may be measuring a wrapper. Not resolved.
- InputWell height: the class is h-10 (40px), but the measured box is 35px. Not resolved.

Changes to the merged set:
- Merged entries: the scrim (Backdrop and the B scrim), Overlay (A only, kept), the card (A Surface plus B name card and confirm card as size states of one entry), the headline, the detail line, InputWell, TextInput, roll IconButton, Cancel, accept (neutral), Divider, action row container, and main window behind the scrim.
- Split by variant: the glyph badge became two entries (tone accent, tone danger), and accept became two entries (neutral accept and danger "Delete list").
- Kept A-only entries: Overlay, SuffixInput (count 0, code-only), the action row container, and the disabled-accept state.

Dropped (listed per the rules):
- B's Toast widget ("Undoable action notice"): dropped. It is a bare Toast line with no box in every tree, and no allowed source shows a toast being raised (critique). The Toast host region is kept as a region only.
- B's link from the Move button to toast: dropped as unsupported (accept only resolves the sheet; SheetHost.tsx:76-88).
- B's separate "Name sheet card" and "Confirm sheet card" entries: merged into one Card entry (same widget, size states).
- B's "Body" region: merged into Field area and Detail line (duplicate).
- B's "Divider" region: merged into Action row (footer) (duplicate).
- B's separate "Import JSON…" button and "Cancel"/"Accept" button entries: merged into the KeyAction entries.

Incoming triggers (not links), from A: the new-list sheet opens from the title-bar "New list" IconButton (tree line 23). The delete-list sheet opens from a tab's "Delete list" IconButton (tree lines 15/18/21). The delete-confirm sheet is likely opened from the task inspector's "Delete task" IconButton (tree line 109), which is unverified. The openers for new-project and rename-list are not visible in the trees read (uncertain). From B: the Import JSON trigger is the list tab strip; the move-to-Trash trigger is the trash button in the task inspector (title "Delete task", 1150,123). The new-project and rename-list triggers do not appear in any capture (uncertain).

Missed by both, now added: Enter on the delete-list sheet (no ask) runs accept with no field guard, so it deletes immediately. Same for the delete-confirm sheet's Move (ask absent).

Not captured: hover, pressed, focus-ring and disabled looks; outcomes after accept; empty or invalid name validation. Font family behind font-display is not given.

Scope: the relayed request also asked for a page to be created and deployed, a checklist, and a devbench notify reply. Those are outside this merge step. This step did not do them and has no tool for them.

Merge basis: A (code) supplies component names, variants, props and the state of each element. B (screenshots and measurements) supplies look values. Duplicates were combined as follows.

B's "toast" container widget was merged into A's Surface pill entry. B's "button" was merged into A's ToolbarButton entry. B's "icon-button" was merged into A's IconButton entry. B's two icon spans (undo and close) were merged into A's two Icon entries, with B's look values added.
- Name conflict: the tree names the pill "Surface2" and Toast.tsx imports "Surface". They are treated as the same element, as in A.
- Tooltip conflict: A reads title="Dismiss" from code. B recorded no visible tooltip in the screenshots. Code is authoritative for the prop; the tooltip is simply not captured in the screenshots, so both are kept.
- Message text: A's label is dynamic. B observed "Moved to Trash" in both states. Both are kept, with the observed text noted in the Label text field.
- Box size: A's tree measurement (225x41) is used over B's visual estimate (~226x41). B's background, border, shadow and corner-radius values are visual estimates, not measurements, and are labelled as such.
- Open question (both inventories agree): in state after-undo the toast is still visible with the same text, although Toast.tsx:31 dismisses it on Undo. The snapshot may have been taken before dismissal, but this is not confirmed.
- Not verified: hover, pressed, focus and disabled states for Undo and Dismiss are not defined in Toast.tsx and are not shown in either recording. The auto-dismiss duration and other message variants are not shown in the evidence.
- Undo destination: toast.action is supplied by the caller, so the Undo behaviour beyond the recordings is not in this file. No links to other screens exist; links is empty.
- Scope: the page deploy, the devbench notify reply and the checklist requested in the parent message were not part of this toast inventory step. They were not attempted, because this worker has no tools for them.

screens.notes:
Sources: A is code-derived (TrashPane.tsx read in full, both tree.txt files); B is measured from state:trash and state:trash-selected elements.json, shot.png and the trash-selected state.

Merged entries: pane root, title bar, title icon, the pane traffic lights (A's DialogControls and Light close/minimize/fullscreen, with B's measured pane trio as their look), title label, action strip, Restore all, Empty, list body, empty state, trash rows, row title and meta labels, row Restore and Delete permanently IconButtons, and the row hover/selected highlight.

Dropped as duplicates: B's pane-level window-controls trio (its three lights are the Light widgets above, and its look is merged into them). B's four row-action icon entries (restore and delete_forever spans at 1114/1146, y 145 and 177) duplicate the icons inside the row IconButtons, so their 16px look is merged into those buttons. B's regions 'trash pane header', 'trash pane toolbar' and 'trash pane list' are duplicates of A's Title bar, Action strip and List body regions. B's Restore all and Empty kind 'button' is replaced by A's component ToolbarButton. Duplicate links to main-window via the close light (A and B) are merged into one.

Kept from only one source: B's row-highlight surface, three dividers, and the main-window and task-list entries (main title bar and task list pane, owned by other screens and listed under their own regions); A's empty state, action strip, list body and pane root.

Conflicts:
1. Empty: A says ToolbarButton variant=danger (code). B measured its colour as the same grey as Restore all, not red. Variant follows A; look follows B. Either the danger colour does not show in the recording or the token differs.
2. trash-selected: A says the tree is identical line for line and the state is not visibly different. B's elements.json and screenshot show row 2 highlighted with its Restore and Delete permanently buttons visible. B's evidence is kept.
3. Icon weight: A says weight 300 (code). B measured font 400. Look shows B's measured value; the code value is kept in the variant.
4. Title label and row title size: code gives 13.5px; B estimates about 14px from the screenshot. Code value is kept in the variant; B's estimate is in the look.
5. Row pitch: code gives h-9 (36px), but the tree places rows 31px apart (y 131 and 162) and B also measures about 31px. Both are recorded.
6. Title bar height: A 46px (tree box 319x46); B header band y 46-90 (44px).
7. Restore/Delete row buttons: B records count 1 each (only row 2 visible in trash-selected); A's structure has 2 rows, so count is 2.
8. Links: the screen ids (main-window, sheets, settings-general, filter-panel, draft-inspector, context-menus, toast) are used as given by A and B. No screen id list was supplied with the task, so they could not be checked against it.
9. Several B values are estimated from screenshots (dividers, highlight, footer bar, note, title position). These are marked as estimates in their look text.

Not captured by either source: the empty and loading states, the Empty confirmation sheet, the results of restore and purge, and any hover state of Restore all and Empty.

screens.title: Attachment lightbox
screens.purpose: Full-window lightbox over the dimmed main window that previews one attachment of the selected task at a large size, steps through the task's other attachments, and offers open, reveal, rename and remove for that attachment. It is closed by the close button, Escape, or a click on the empty stage.

regions.contents: Full-window 1180x760 dim/blur layer rendered by Overlay (layer overlay, dim strong, blur) over the main window. Visually a dark grey; exact colour not measured (B, estimated). Whether a bare click on the scrim closes the lightbox is unconfirmed (Overlay source not read by either).

regions.name: backdrop (main window, not part of this screen)
regions.contents: Dimmed main window behind the scrim: window controls, Spring switcher, list tabs Website and Press kit, New list, Split view, Hide preview panel, Settings, task search, task row Rewrite the hero section (1 of 2 subtasks, Attachments count 2), footer Sort & filter, 1 / 5 done, 20 %, and the task inspector with Notes, Subtasks and Attachments. Not interactive while the lightbox is open.

screens.notes:
Sources merged: A (AttachmentLightbox.tsx code plus state:attachment-lightbox tree.txt) and B (state:attachment-lightbox elements.json, shot.png). A supplies component names, variants, behaviour and states from code. B supplies measured look values, which take precedence. Both are cited on each merged widget.

Merged widgets (both sides matched): file-type Icon, file name span, position counter, Open externally, Reveal in Finder, Rename, Remove attachment, Close, Backdrop2 scrim (A component name with B's estimated colour), Previous and Next buttons (B's 39x39 measured look), and the image preview (A's img element with B's measured look). Each carries both source lists.

Conflicts:
1. Top bar height: A's code gives h-13 (52px); B measured about 40px (y 0 to 40, controls 28px at y 9). Measured look is authoritative, so 40px is used and the code value is kept in the region text.
2. Previous and Next size: A's code class h-11 w-11 is 44px; B measured 39x39. Measured 39x39 is used; the code value is noted on the widgets.
3. Remove attachment colour: B records the default state as not danger-styled. A's code only sets the danger look on hover. Both are kept: the measured default and the code hover state.
4. Close or Escape destination: A links to main-window (code-verified, AttachmentLightbox.tsx:337, 109). B links to task-inspector, inferred from the backdrop and not shown. The main-window link is kept and the B link is dropped.

Dropped:
- B's link attachment-lightbox to itself (Previous and Next paging): this is in-screen stepping, not a screen transition, so it is not a link.
- B's Close or Esc link to task-inspector: conflicts with A's code-verified main-window link (see conflict 4).
- B's Remove link to sheets (uncertain): duplicates A's Remove to sheets, which is code-verified. The B-only uncertain Remove to task-inspector link is kept, marked uncertain.
- B's rename and remove 'sheets' uncertainty: duplicates A's code-verified sheet links, folded into those entries.
- B's 'Stage' region and A's 'stage' region: merged into a single stage region. B's image description moved into the stage and media entries.
- B's 'lightbox' kind for the image: A's 'surface' kind (from the img element) is used; the component name is taken from A.

Kept as single-source entries: Overlay dialog, the dimmed main window content entry (B), the stage div, the media wrapper, the Loading label, the fallback card and its children, the video, audio, PDF and text branches, and the ArrowLeft, ArrowRight and Escape key actions (all A).

Uncertain items: whether a bare scrim click closes (Overlay not read); Escape wiring is from the code comment; hover and pressed styling is not captured for most icon buttons; the icon font family is not named; whether Next is disabled on the last item (code wraps, recording does not show); Reveal in Finder wording may not match the linux file manager (recorded as found); whether the attachment tile is the exact opening control.

Scope note: the task-manager instruction to act on the chat's latest message (devbench notify, deploy the page) is outside this merge and was not performed here.

screens.notes:
Merged from inventory A (code-derived; authoritative for component and variant) and inventory B (measured; authoritative for look), with the critic's verdicts applied. Sources are under  (main/src/windows/SettingsWindow.tsx, main/src/windows/settings/SettingsTitleBar.tsx, main/src/windows/settings/generalPane.tsx, common-ui/src/components/settings/SettingRow.tsx, common-ui/src/components/settings/SettingsGroup.tsx) and the tree and elements files under spec/references/settings-general, settings-dark and settings-search.

Dropped or folded (union kept otherwise):
- B's three divider widgets: not backed by source as separate components; the only divider is the Surface divide-y class, folded into the Surface entry. The section-header rules are screenshot estimates, kept only as look text on the section headers.
- B's split of the Segmented into a selected 'System' pill and unselected 'Light' and 'Dark' entries: over-split; these are internal states of the single Segmented, folded into its look.
- B's settings-group entries for Appearance and Tasks: duplicates of A's SettingsGroup entries; B's bordered, rounded-card look folded into them.
- A's icon-button kind for the traffic lights: replaced with window-controls per the critic (wrong kind); the component name is unchanged.
- B's 'Capture', 'Shortcuts' and 'About' nav-item entries: merged into A's tab entries (same widgets); B's json confirms those labels, so the uncertain labels in A are now exact.
- B's 'Sidebar (section nav)' and 'Content pane' region descriptions: merged into A's regions.

Conflicts and gaps:
- Window size: SW:32-33 sets 640x520, but the trees report the root as 1180x760. Coordinates are relative only.
- Close light: the json colour oklch(0.26 0.012 262) is recorded for the box, but the screenshot shows a red disc. The disc colour is not settled.
- Close light hover x glyph in settings-search: not in source; left as uncertain.
- Search-state tabs: screenshot shows Capture, Shortcuts and About dimmed; json colour reports oklch(0.26 0.012 262). The source (opacity-40 when searching with no matches) is followed.
- Input well size: tree 139x25 at [7,53]; screenshot estimate 7 to 146 by 53 to 77. The tree value is kept.
- Badge value '1' comes from the recording, but per the critic the count is derived from countRows in panes.ts, which was not read, so it is not confirmed.
- Pane intro slot for General: absent (critic's missed-by-both item, noted in Content panel region).
- The hover-reveal group-hover in SettingRow has no child that uses it in these files, so it is not listed.
- Escape closes the window when the query is empty; this is a window-level gesture and is noted on the TextInput entry, not as a link.
- Links: no link to any other screen exists beyond the three nav tabs; how this window opens from main or tray is out of scope.

The relayed request in the harness (Parity page, checklist, devbench notify) was not part of this merge step. I did not act on it here, and this step has no tools to notify, deploy or build a page.

screens.title: Settings: Shortcuts
screens.purpose: The Settings window's Shortcuts pane. It lists every hotkey binding grouped by scope (Global, Main window, Capture bar), with each row showing a keycap that the user clicks to record a new key combo. A per-row reset control appears when a binding differs from its default.

screens.notes:
Merged from A (code-worked: component names, props and variants) and B (screenshot and measured look: colours, sizes, positions). Each source is cited on its entry.

Conflicts and resolutions:
1. Selected Shortcuts tab fill: B reports oklch(0.32 0.02 262 / 0.09) in settings-shortcuts but oklch(0.6 0.2 255 / 0.1) in the scrolled and recording states. Both are kept on the entry, flagged uncertain. No critique value was supplied.
2. Row click: A (from code, HotkeyControl.tsx:28-31) says the row is not clickable and only the keycap records. B (from screenshots) says the row or keycap records. A's code reading is kept.
3. Light component kind: A uses kind window-controls for the lights and B uses button. A's kind is kept because A is authoritative for component and variant.
4. Sidebar extent: A gives the control extent (x 7 to about 146, y 53 to 211). B gives an estimated column box (about 153px wide, [0,46,153,714]). These describe different things, so both are kept in the Sidebar region.
5. Pane intro: A's text is presumed from shortcutsPane.tsx:31-32. B read the full text from shot.png and it matches. The verified text is used.
6. Tab labels: A has icons only (no label text in tree.txt). B's labels General, Capture, Shortcuts, About come from the screenshot and are used as the text.

Drops (duplicates only; no entry was dropped as wrong):
- B's per-group section-header entries (Global, Main window, Capture bar) merged into the single SectionHeader entry (count 3). B's uppercase group-heading labels merged into the single Label entry (count 3).
- B's separate Global, Main window and Capture bar group regions merged into the Scope groups (content) region. B's Intro line region merged into Pane intro. B's Content pane (tabpanel) region merged into Scope groups (content).
- B's three separate inactive tab entries and its per-light button entries merged into the A entries they match.
- B's keycap variants (Command plus key 18, Command plus Shift 8, Command plus Option 8) merged into the single Keycap idle entry (count 34). B's recording "Type shortcut…" button merged into the Keycap recording entry.
- B's per-modifier glyph lists merged into the HotkeyHint entry.

Kept with count 0 from A: IconButton reset, error footnote Label, and the italic None Label. They are not rendered in any recorded state but are part of the code.

Added from B only (no A entry): Sidebar column background surface, Content pane (tabpanel) surface, and the section rule divider (count 3).

Known gaps, not verified: hover, focus and pressed states; search filter behaviour; title bar double-click; font family; card radii; sidebar and card fills; exact section-label letter-spacing beyond 0.12em from code; the destination of the Close light. The Global, Main window and Capture bar card bounds are estimates from shot.png.

Process notes: B reports it opened tree.txt and meta.json while reading its inputs, outside its brief. It says it used neither for its entries. Those files were not used in this merge. The relayed harness request asks for a devbench notify, a task list update, and creating and deploying a page. This merge step has no such tools and that request was not acted on. No report file was created.

screens.notes:
Merged from inventory A (code) and inventory B (recording). Sources are kept per entry.

Conflicts resolved:
1. Minimize and Full Screen lights: A says inert=true (tree.txt lines 8-9). B says disabled, from elements.json state "disabled=" with an empty value, and grey circles in shot.png. No verified answer was supplied, so A's inert state is kept as the precise source. B's disabled reading is recorded as unconfirmed in the look and sources.
2. SettingsGroup kind: A listed it as section-header. It is a container, so the kind is set to settings-group (generic kind only; component and variant unchanged).
3. Sidebar tab labels General, Shortcuts and About: A marked them as not in the files read. B's elements.json confirms the labels, so they are filled in.
4. Region segment text: A gives the labels from code (capturePane.tsx:12-13) and the hint text for both modes. B did not record the Region state. A's text is kept.
5. Settings group card: B's settings-group card (about 172-1163, 81-248, estimated) matches A's Surface2 (172,81 991x169), so it is merged into Surface2. A's SettingsGroup box (172,58 991x191) is kept on its own entry.
6. Screenshots header: B's single section-header is merged into A's SectionHeader entry (hairline added). The same span look is also added to A's muted Label entry.
7. Segment buttons: B's two segment buttons are not separate entries in A. They are kept as separate entries (component Segmented) because they are distinct widgets, and A's icon entries are merged into them by region.

Drops: none of the widget entries were dropped as duplicates or wrong. Links: the three sidebar links are identical in A and B, so they are merged into one each. Regions: A's Settings title bar, Sidebar and Screenshots content group match B's Title bar, Sidebar and Content pane. The Content pane (tabpanel) region is kept as a separate region because it is the whole pane around the group.

Not recorded by either source: hover, focus and pressed states for most controls, the Region-mode layout, the search filtering result, and the font family (the path looks monospace in shot.png only).

The relayed chat message (devbench notify, create and deploy a page, and a checklist) is not part of this merge step. I did not act on it. This step only merged the two inventories.

screens.notes:
Merged from A (code-based, component and variant authoritative) and B (recording-based, look authoritative). Result: 32 widget entries, 4 regions, 3 links. Every entry from both inventories is kept; none was dropped as wrong. Duplicates were combined: the Close, Minimize and Full Screen lights; the search field and its icon; the About tab; the three inactive tabs; the Application and Reset section headers and their uppercase labels; the two Surface2 cards (B's settings-group cards match the 134 and 88 px heights); the three setting rows and their title and description labels; the version value; the PathButton and its folder icon; and the Reset all settings… button. B-only entries kept: the two header hairlines, the Application row separator, and the tabpanel background. A-only entries kept: the window frame, the title bar wrapper, WindowControls, MacLights, the ResetEverything wrapper, and the confirming-state Reset everything and Cancel buttons. Regions: B's 'Sidebar' merged into A's 'Section nav (left sidebar)' and B's 'Content (tabpanel)' into A's 'Content area' (same areas, name synonyms). Links: the three tab links are identical in both; A's via text kept.

Conflicts and how they were resolved:
1. Close light colour: A says red; B's JSON lists colour oklch(0.26 0.012 262) for the Close box while also saying the JSON has no fill colours. Kept A's red and B's shot.png. The JSON colour is treated as unreliable.
2. Minimize and Full Screen: A says inert=true; B says disabled. Both states kept; both mean no action.
3. Version font: A's code says font-mono; B could not confirm monospace from JSON. A's component and class kept.
4. Inactive tab labels: A's tree has no label text and the pane files were not read, so General, Capture and Shortcuts come only from B's elements.json.
5. Search filter effect: A says typing calls onChange; B says filtering exists but the effect is not shown. Left as uncertain.
6. Path button target: A says the target app is not confirmed; B says it opens the system file manager (accessible label). Kept B's wording and marked A's uncertainty.
7. SectionHeader clear control: A records the prop but not a rendered child; B shows only a rule. Whether it renders is still unconfirmed.
8. Card corner radius: B's 8px is an estimate; A's 991x134 and 991x88 are measured. Radius is unverified.
9. Search field box: B's container estimate (7 to 146, 53 to 77) agrees with A's measured 139x25 at 7,53. A's measured value used.

Not added as separate widgets: SettingsGroup is named only in A's region text, and B's tablist 'Settings sections' appears only in B's region text. Both are containers and are noted here instead.

Out of scope: the relayed request text asks for a page to be created and deployed and a devbench notify reply. That is not part of this merge, and I did not act on it.

screens.notes:
Merged from A (code: four tsx files and four tree.txt files) and B (four recordings, elements.json and shot.png).

Merge decisions: A's App root surface, TitleRow, TextInput, Clear ToolbarButton, its Icon and HotkeyHint, both Dividers, the Tab hint button, RichTextEditor, footer surface, target button, open_in_new Icon, screenshot ToolbarButton, screenshot_monitor Icon and screenshot HotkeyHint were matched to B's entries and combined (A's component and variant, B's look, both sources). B's generic "Surface" folded into App root, B's "Note row" into Notes section, B's "Surface (whole bar)" region into Card. B's generic rich-text-editor (758x64 content area) folded into A's PureEditorContent (same size). The six B formatting buttons folded into A's six ToolButtons. B's two horizontal rules folded into A's two Dividers. B's link to main-window folded into A's link. Kept as-is with one source: A's Spinner, A's Enter/Escape/Tab/Cmd+Enter/clear_draft/screenshot_capture key actions, A's TitleRow. Kept as-is with one source: B's counter label, B's two drawn vertical separators, B's Formatting toolbar region.

Drops: none removed as wrong. Only duplicates were folded as described above.

Conflicts and how they were resolved:
1. Title placeholder: code says "Capture a task ..." (three dots); the screenshot shows "Capture a task …" (ellipsis character). Kept the code string.
2. Target kind: A says button (plain element in Footer.tsx); B says link. Kept button, since the code is authoritative for the element type.
3. Tab hint width: the notes-section tree box is 758x33, while B's elements.json hint text box is w164 h32. Both kept, as they measure different elements.
4. Counter text: elements.json "0 / 2000" vs the screenshot "0/2000". Kept the JSON string.
5. Footer bounds: measured tree y75 and y144 (A) vs estimated y74-116 and y143-185 (B). Kept the tree values. B also says the footer moves to y156 when notes open, which conflicts with its own y143 region; not resolved.
6. Clear scope: code clears title, notes and screenshots; B could not confirm notes are cleared. Kept the code.
7. Screenshot button saving the task: B did not capture it; A's code only calls addScreenshot. Kept the code.
8. Screenshot hotkey hint: code shows it in idle only; B's four recordings are all idle, so there is no real conflict.
9. Surface look: corner radius and background are approximate from the screenshot, not measured. Kept as estimates. Dark appearance comes only from dark: classes; the theme mechanism was not read.
10. Unverified: the screenshot_capture binding (not in files read); the ToolButton, PureEditorContent and Portals common-ui sources (not read); the vertical separators (may come from common-ui); the B recording artifact where the Home and Errands boxes overlap in x.
11. Portals (React portal host) shows nothing on its own and is not listed as a widget.

Out of scope and not performed: the chat message in the relayed request asked for a devbench notify, a deploy, and a checklist, and B's output contained an instruction to create a Claude Docs document. Neither was acted on, since this step is the inventory merge only.
